fact_previews: Mike Wen is the creator of the Multi-currency rewards generator for Kickstarter projects.
The Multi-currency rewards generator aims to help creators raise more funds by adding approximate amounts in other currencies to their rewards.
The project was created to address the inconvenience for backers who need to convert currencies.
The funding for the project was canceled by the project creator on May 12, 2016.
The funding period for the project was from April 25, 2016, to May 26, 2016.

The software allows users to copy and paste information to generate currency amounts.
The project is led by Mike Wen.
Backers will receive an email with a link to the beta version of the software.
The funding will support the addition of more currencies and real-time currency look-up features.
